description: Six routes R0-13e's route-shadowing.spec.ts found dead behind a parameterised sibling are declared first and reach their own handlers, and each newly reachable handler is proven guarded, scoped and tenant-bound on a real database (k13f_): GET approvals/pending-for-me (was getById as approval 'pending-for-me'; web: fetchPendingApprovalsForMe on app/approvals and app/operations), POST command items/bulk/complete and items/bulk/dismiss (were complete/dismiss as item 'bulk'; web: bulkCompleteCommands/bulkDismissCommands, no screen yet), POST crm deals/bulk/move-stage (was moveStage as deal 'bulk'; web: bulkMoveDealStage on the deals board and list) and GET procurement suppliers and stats (were get as request 'suppliers'/'stats'; web: the suppliers page, the request vendor picker, the procurement page). Guards: each handler carries every guard of its single-item sibling (route-shadowing.spec.ts reads them statically): 401 unauthenticated and 403 for a non-member on all six, and the bulk move needs the single move's crm write (a crm read member 403). Tenant: another tenant's command item is refused exactly like an unknown id (the bulk is all-or-nothing, nothing written, no event), another tenant's deal is skipped with the per-id result an unknown id gets (bulkMoveStage delegates each id to moveStage, the single move's own tenant check, reused) and its row and contact events are unchanged, another tenant's stage moves nothing, and pending-for-me, suppliers and stats read only the path business. Input: the bulk move body is BulkMoveDealsStageDto (crm-deals.controller.ts, BulkMoveStageDto plus a string per deal id), since BulkMoveStageDto let a Prisma filter object such as { not: '' } through to moveStage's findFirst; the command bulk body stays BulkCommandItemsDto; a malformed body answers 400 and writes nothing. vitest emits no decorator metadata, so the suite applies the parameter types tsc emits and two cases read them from the sources. Run from apps/server against a migrated local database and REDIS_URL: npx vitest run test/shadowed-routes-live.integration.test.ts test/key-cortex-flows-routes.integration.test.ts src/core/config/route-shadowing.spec.ts --reporter=json --outputFile=.proof/r0-13g-vitest.json, then node ../../scripts/proof-admission/evaluate.mjs --manifest ../../scripts/proof-admission/manifests/shadowed-routes-live.json --report .proof/r0-13g-vitest.json (R0-13g added the second and third files). RED-BEFORE on 87fb3e09 (tests-first commit 17f87369): 14 of 17 fail, exactly the NEGATIVE CONTROL cases (each route answers its sibling's 404: 'Approval request not found', 'Command item not found', 'Deal not found', 'Request not found'; tsc emits BulkMoveStageDto for the bulk move body); fixture sanity and the two refusal cases (401, 403) pass, as the sibling carried the same guards. route-shadowing.spec.ts: 2 of 14 fail (the six unlisted offenders, the R0-13f ordering case). GREEN-AFTER: 17 of 17; the spec 14 of 14 with only the two key-cortex flows entries left in ALLOW_LISTED. Review repairs (two cases added, RED on e321df82, the packet head, GREEN after): the bulk move answered a NUL byte or an unpaired surrogate in a deal id or stageId with a 201 whose per-id error was Prisma's raw message (server source path, code frame, PostgresError), since bulkMoveStage returns each caught error's message; BulkMoveDealsStageDto now refuses such text per id and in stageId with 400 before any deal moves, while a well-formed id keeps its per-id result. The approvals siblings (get, approve, reject, delegate, cancel, escalate) looked the request up by id alone, so a member of any business read or escalated another tenant's request through their own business's path; ApprovalController now answers another tenant's request exactly like an unknown id (404) before any service call, and the request's own business still answers. GREEN-AFTER the repairs: 19 of 19. R0-13g-KEY-FLOWS-ROUTES extends this manifest with the last two (k13g_, test/key-cortex-flows-routes.integration.test.ts) and binds route-shadowing.spec.ts: GET /api/v1/cortex/flows/templates and GET flows/nodes (key-cortex.controller.ts; no web screen calls either, apps/web reads flow templates from /api/flows/businesses/:businessId/templates, modules/flow) are declared before GET flows/:id and reach flowTemplates and flowNodes. At the base flowGet answered both with 503 'Unable to retrieve flow', not a 404: it calls flowStudio.get, which KeyCortexFlowStudioService does not have (the controller holds the service as any). The two handlers were broken as well: flowTemplates called flowStudio.listTemplates (absent; it now answers getTemplates() as { templates }, narrowed by an optional category matched without regard to case, a repeated category 400, the parameter typed unknown so tsc emits Object and the ValidationPipe does not join a repeated value into one string), and flowNodes returned getNodeRegistry()'s bare array (now { nodes }, the shape it declared); both hold the service through its type, so tsc checks the two calls. Guards: the class's AuthGuard and BusinessGuard, exactly flowGet's (it has no module scope): 401 unauthenticated, 403 for a non-member and with no business named. Tenant and actor: neither handler reads a tenant or an actor (route-shadowing.spec.ts reads their parameters: only @Query('category')); both answer a global catalogue, byte-identical for two tenants' owners and a STAFF member with no module scopes, carrying no tenant's flow definition and no business id, writing nothing; a ?userId or body userId changes nothing, and a body businessId is the tenant BusinessGuard checks (403 for a non-member). ALLOW_LISTED in route-shadowing.spec.ts is empty, and a case keeps it empty and the tree free of offenders. RED-BEFORE on 77f3aabf (tests-first commit e7608b00): the k13g suite 5 of 9 fail, exactly the NEGATIVE CONTROL cases (flowGet's 503); fixture sanity and the 401/403 refusal cases pass, as flowGet ran behind the same guards; route-shadowing.spec.ts 3 of 18 fail (the two unlisted key-cortex offenders, the empty-allow-list case, the R0-13g ordering case). GREEN-AFTER: the k13g suite 9 of 9, the spec 18 of 18, the k13f suite 19 of 19 (46 required cases). allowAdditionalCases is false: a change that adds, renames or removes a case in any of the three files must make the same change here.
